displayName: Gameday report FELL BACK or FAILED

documentation.content: The agent failed and the user got the rule-based report (`source=fallback`), or the user got no report at all (`source=failed`: an exception, the run exits 1). Neither is always a failed execution: a fallback exits 0, and a failed attempt that the job's retry then delivers leaves the execution Completed (10/29: u1's agent returned MALFORMED_RESPONSE, the rule-based fallback then crashed with a KeyError, the retry delivered, and nothing paged). Look at the `agent failed:` / `FAILED:` lines in the gameday-report logs.

conditions.displayName: Gameday report FELL BACK or FAILED

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="gameday-report" AND jsonPayload.event="report" AND jsonPayload.dry_run=false AND (jsonPayload.source="fallback" OR jsonPayload.source="failed")
